About Bay Breeze Realty

Our Story

From the classroom to the closing table

Bay Breeze Realty started from a simple frustration: watching eager first-time buyers get outbid, overwhelmed, and talked down to by traditional corporate agents. Founded by two former educators who traded the whiteboard for the waterfront, our brokerage brings a patient, teacher-first mentality to Alameda, Oakland, and the East Bay.

We believe everyone deserves to understand the real estate process clearly, without jargon or high-pressure sales tactics. Our team is deeply rooted in local marina and coastal neighborhoods, treating your home purchase as a major life milestone rather than just another transaction.

We remain deliberately approachable and down-to-earth. We are the real estate partners you actually want to grab a coffee with after closing day.

What Drives Us

Our approach and values

◆

Education First

No jargon or pushy tactics. We break down every contract and market trend in plain English so you feel completely confident.

◆

We live and breathe Alameda, Oakland, and East Bay waterfront communities, knowing every micro-market intimately.

◆

Collaborative Fun

House-hunting should be exciting, not stressful. Our weekend open house crawls turn the search into an adventure.

◆

Community Focus

From free monthly workshops at the library to ongoing neighborhood guidance, we are invested in our community.
